models_evaluated: GI Genius Intelligent Endoscopy Module CADx

links.outcome: Negative predictive value of adenoma characterization by anatomic region, reflecting local polyp prevalence
links.effect: NPV was 80.3% for rectosigmoid lesions vs 54.2% for colonic lesions, attributed to hyperplastic polyp prevalence of 11.4% vs 5.4%. Overall sensitivity 89.4%, specificity 61.7%, NPV 69.8%.
links.quote: The negative predictive value for rectosigmoid lesions (80.3%) was notably higher than for colonic lesions (54.2%), attributed to the increased prevalence of hyperplastic rectosigmoid polyps (11.4%) vs other colonic regions (5.4%).

screen.reason: Prospective cohort study evaluating the real-world clinical accuracy and diagnostic performance of an existing commercial computer-assisted diagnosis system (GI Genius) during colonoscopies.
